entities.summary: Zoë Anina Kressler, known professionally as Zoë Më, is a Swiss singer and songwriter. She represented Switzerland in the Eurovision Song Contest 2025 on home soil in Basel with the song "Voyage", finishing in 10th place overall with 214 points.
